text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before beginning our training for the
day, I
explain today's regimen to Sweep
Tosho.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...No. Whenever I run in the dirt, it gets
in my
shoes, so I'm not doing it.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I don't like ramp training either. It makes
me
tired.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho doesn't seem to be in the
mood to
cooperate. Maybe I can interest
her with...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
choice_data_list: Let's slip in some magical training in between.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I don't feel like moving today! I'm just
gonna sit
here and watch TV! I'm not
moving one inch from
this spot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She won't even bite on something she's
interested
in. She may still be exhausted
from racing, so I
might need to rethink
her schedule.
